vetSays.line: 🛡️ Luna, Benoit, Tom and Amina met them at the door — 4 put down. Luna, Tom, Amina are hurt.
🛡️ Luna, Dorothy, Cecília, Benoit and Tom met them at the door — 5 put down. Luna, Dorothy, Cecília, Benoit, Tom are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Cecília just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Luna, Dorothy, Cecília, Giulia and Benoit met them at the door — 5 put down. Luna, Dorothy, Cecília, Giulia, Benoit are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Luna just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Amina just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Luna, Benoit, Tom and Amina met them at the door — 4 put down. Luna, Tom, Amina are hurt.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tom just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Luna, Tom, Amina and Leo met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Luna, Tom, Amina are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Giulia just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chen just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Salvatore and Chen met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Salvatore is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
Salvatore has been turning the Ground Elder over — asking after it at fires, handling it on work days — and now knows it deep enough to teach. (Their trade grows: ask them what they know.)
Chen has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Salvatore drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
💡 Ground Elder: the village and a trader know more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
